reviews.comment: Routing + security solid (security pass clean: no header-injection/open-redirect/SSRF/XSS/cache-poisoning). 1 blocker: overview now full-re-renders on every project-update (upsertProject->renderSections->innerHTML), which destroys an in-flight Start button and, since /start has no in-flight guard, enables a double-spawn; restore targeted per-card updates + only regroup on section change. Non-blocking: getByProjectId via index; /p/<id>/hub redirect->404; 301 Cache-Control: no-store.

fix.comment: Fixed blocker + 3 non-blocking. Blocker: overview targeted per-card updates + startingIds/applyStartingState (Starting survives re-renders) + server /start in-flight dedup (202). NB1: registry.getByProjectId via index. NB2: /p/<id>/hub/* -> 404. NB3: 301 Cache-Control no-store. Verified live + 342 tests.

reviews.comment: Round 2 APPROVED. Blocker + 3 non-blocking all verified fixed (targeted updates + startingIds/applyStartingState + server /start dedup 202; getByProjectId; /p/hub 404; 301 no-store). Re-review found 1 new minor issue (startingIds not cleared on online -> stale Starting button on a non-navigating tab) and fixed it (clear-on-online + 20s safety timeout). 342 tests, live-verified.
